items.title: Candido Camero — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he was my interpreter because I could not speak a word (of English) with Dizzy... Catalino served as interpreter... thanks for everything, for serving as interpreter.

ctx.x: His name is Catalino Rolon. So then, he was my interpreter because I could not speak a word (of English) with Dizzy. I did not know any English and he could not speak much Spanish. So Catalino served as interpreter because Dizzy wanted me to audition. He wanted to hear me because he was looking for a conga player and I said I am willing and they asked me if I had ever played jazz and I said, "Well I've heard a lot of jazz and I like jazz but I have not played jazz." He says, "Well what do you think?" I said,…
